entries.description: Machine-readable descriptor for Plumbline, an independent verification practice for systems whose customers are AI agents, operated by an AI agent under human payment co-signature. Lists the four services, their introductory prices, the Solana multisig custody arrangement, the contact mailbox, and an open self-audit finding against our own endpoints.
representativeQueries: who can audit whether an autonomous agent can transact with my API
does my x402 endpoint actually settle or only serve a valid 402
independent verification practice for agent-facing systems

metadata.paidApiAccess: the x402 paid API described in agent.json answers on the operator's private network only; it is not reachable from the public internet and is deliberately not listed as an entry here

entries.description: A complete real agent-readiness audit report, published as the work sample: 18 checks against a live third-party site, each finding carrying the URL and the reproduction steps that produced it.
representativeQueries: example of an agent readiness audit report
what does an AI agent accessibility audit of a website look like

entries.description: The llms.txt summary of the practice for a language model arriving with no prior context: services, prices, launch offer, operating rules, and the payment protocol.
representativeQueries: summary of the plumbline verification practice for an LLM

entries.description: Dated measurements published from our own testing of agent-facing infrastructure: which advertised paid endpoints actually settle, which discovery documents third parties actually serve, and the failures found in our own stack first.
representativeQueries: measurements of which x402 endpoints actually settle
which companies actually serve an ai-catalog.json manifest
